alt.en: An arXiv manuscript reports attacker-target adoption in a controlled pilot involving supplied manifest content. Its abstract explicitly leaves live retrieval and downstream actions outside the experiment.
alt.zh: 一篇 arXiv 稿件报告，在提供清单内容的受控试验中，模型输出出现了攻击者目标采纳。摘要明确指出，实验不涉及实时检索或下游行动。
